title: Air Inter 696
summary: The Vickers Viscount took off from Lyon in a violent thunderstorm and crashed during approach to Clermont-Ferrand Airport. After last radio contact was lost, the aircraft struck the Mont Picot massif in the Forez mountains at 1,000 meters altitude, approximately 10 kilometers from the airport during poor visibility conditions.
probable_cause: The crew encountered severe weather and lost radio contact while on approach. The aircraft descended below safe altitude and struck mountainous terrain during an instrument approach in conditions of poor visibility.
